name: needt
description: Needt: your planner in every chat, plus a business partner, a prompt builder, a YouTube reader, a researcher that reads YouTube, X and GitHub, a clickable interview, a plan critic, and memory that follows you.

interface.shortDescription: Think together, write the right prompt, find the good stuff.
interface.longDescription: Partner thinks with you and prepares business work. Prompt turns a rough wish into one well-built prompt sized to the task. Search finds the non-obvious good option, verified and sourced. Asking stress-tests a plan through rounds of clickable questions.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started: recommend a first move and prepare it.
Turn this rough idea into one strong prompt.
Find the best way to do this, with sources.
